svg.title: osctrl components
svg.desc: osquery nodes and operators reach osctrl over the internet through nginx, which terminates TLS. osctrl-tls serves the osquery remote API and the osctrld bootstrap endpoints. The frontend talks to osctrl-api with a JWT, and osctrl-cli and osctrl-mcp use the same API. Both services read and write PostgreSQL and Redis and report metrics; osctrl-tls exports osquery logs to the configured sinks, and osctrl-api dispatches alerts to webhook and email channels.
svg.text: one host: the client spawns the server
